labels.summary: Batch indexes were never reset between recursive CTE iterations, so a stale batch index state carried over and broke the rescheduled pipeline (reported via a query combining a replacement scan and a recursive CTE); the fix resets them on reschedule when partitioning requires it and splits the reset out of ClearSource.
